title: Creole language and Reason's family background
summary: Asked about French and Creole, Reason says his mother's family was Creole and gives her maiden name.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you speak French yourself? You speak Creole?

No. A little bit I did know when I got to King Alvarez's band, he said, forget it. He said, you come here with that band. He said, these boys be mad in this band. Yeah. He said, most of those fellas, they were from up north. Yeah. New York, you mean. And they always thought you was talking about them. Mm-hmm. So, you know, it was, you speak, Mr.
But you could understand if I said something like, come on, say, yay.
Little stuff like that. Yeah. You can still remember a little. Yeah. A little dirty thing.
Well, I guess you, you must have heard it growing up, so.
Oh, yeah. My folks were most of them on my mother's side.
Creole people. Right over there in the block in the middle of town. That's where I was born. What's her name? What was her name? My mother. A maiden name. Craig. C-R-A-I-G.
